name: Focus and Max home
promise: A calm view of what matters today, or every number when you want it
what: Leadership opens on Focus: a greeting, four key cards, a ranked Next up stack and what Pulse noticed. Max mode adds six headline numbers, invoiced against collected, money owed by age and the full queue.

name: Chat-first workspace
promise: Start every day in one box that opens chats, pages and work instantly
what: On a computer Pulse opens on Chats: one box (@name, / commands, words or links), Needs you with tasks, steps and mentions, and Pip noticing when a message means a place and opening it beside the chat.

name: Role-based homes
promise: Each role lands on its own home: sales queues, site visits, quotes to send
what: Admins choose per role whether people land on the dashboard or a sales home (urgent tasks, today's calls, latest quotes); every role a person holds adds its own tiles of steps to do.

name: My desk
promise: Your own day in one place: check-in, what is due, requests and pay
what: A personal home with five tabs (Today, Time, Growth, Requests, About me): check-in, what is due, attendance, leave, approvals, kudos from colleagues and your own attendance and payslip history.

name: Leadership people view
promise: See value against cost, role seats and staffing gaps before they bite
what: Leadership sees each person's value against cost (never ranked), role seats and who held them, staffing gaps (unowned work, overload, single points of failure) and the top people risks.

name: Updates
promise: Hand-off updates reach the right people, with read receipts
what: Updates addressed to people appear as a Home card and an Updates page, with a bell entry and a push to browser, desktop and phone, plus who has opened each one.

name: Role briefs
promise: A short, evidence-backed brief of what changed and what is missing for your role
what: Frozen, per-role briefs built from authorised evidence show positive changes and missing inputs, each with its receipt and an accountable action preview.

name: Insights drawer
promise: Ask Pip about any page and get explained, sourced insights beside it
what: An insights drawer opens beside the page from Pip's 'Ask Pip' or the account menu, with explained findings and the place to act; domains without data say what intake is missing.

name: Search everything
promise: Ctrl+K finds any page, person, client, task, chat or policy in a moment
what: The command palette answers pages, settings, actions, people and clients instantly from the browser, then streams tasks, projects, chats, SOPs, policies and places from the server, respecting what each person may see.

name: Smart notifications
promise: A bell that counts only what needs you and folds the rest
what: Notifications are ranked Urgent, Needs your action and For your information, folded by kind, with one-tap actions in the panel, mutes per kind, quiet hours and one daily HR digest.

name: Tasks in every view
promise: See work as a list, board, table, calendar, timeline or gallery
what: Tasks for any scope drawn as list, board, table, calendar, timeline or gallery, with saved views; one-line entry reads '@Datup #Pulse fri !high' into a task, and C creates one anywhere.

name: Work projects
promise: Run internal and fulfilment projects with a clear glance strip
what: Work projects hold tasks with a glance strip (done, open, blocked, finished, people), categories and owners, kept separate from client projects that live under Clients.

name: Team dashboard
promise: See what every pod is on, what is late and who is overloaded
what: A management dashboard of the team's tasks by person and pod, with late and blocked work and drill-down into any person's Work page.

name: Task focus page
promise: Every task answers what, by when and how, with what it unlocks
what: The task page shows a checklist from the notes, where it stands and its next action, what finishing it unlocks, the same work elsewhere and an unlock map of the biggest blockers.

name: Plan it with Pip
promise: Pip suggests the steps, the fastest path and who to ask
what: For any task Pip proposes steps, the fastest path, who to ask and a message ready to copy, plus suggested importance and effort with reasons; nothing is sent without you.

name: Finish and review
promise: Work counts only when someone else accepts it
what: Finishing checks open subtasks; the reviewer gives one quality rating or sends it back from wherever they are; there are no gameable value points.

name: Task companion
promise: Pulse spots when a task is done and takes you straight to the right button
what: The task companion follows you with the task's steps and signals, marks work done when the evidence shows it (with Undo), and 'Go there' links glow the exact control on the target page.

name: Work pool
promise: Unowned work is proposed from your data and claimed by the right pod
what: Pulse proposes pool tasks from Drive folders, usual package steps and unowned tracker rows, routed to the pod that usually does them; leaders approve batches and set responsibility domains.

name: Outcomes
promise: See what each person really delivered, week by week
what: Twelve weeks of accepted work by project and domain, tasks done, hours, extra work and streaks against a person's usual week, plus a personal My week view; only work someone else accepted counts.

name: Processes library
promise: Every way your company works, written and runnable, in one list
what: One library of processes (write-up plus steps) showing each one as written only, steps drafted or live with its runs; older SOPs, workflows and boards are read in so nothing is lost.

name: Process builder
promise: Build a process as a simple list, or see it as a full-screen map
what: Build from about a dozen plain blocks (Start, Task, Collect, Meet, Write, Review, Decide, Wait, Message, AI, App action, Repeat, End) and your own saved blocks, as a list or full-screen map; Go live versions it.

name: Describe it
promise: Type how the work goes and Pip drafts the steps
what: Describe a process in plain words, or pick an existing write-up, and Pip drafts the steps with who does each and when, saying clearly what it could not tell.

name: Try it test runs
promise: Rehearse a process as each person before anyone is affected
what: Run a draft as a test project with sample data, stepping into each role in turn, seeing alerts and due dates, fast-forwarding days, then throwing it away; nobody is notified.

name: Runs and live engine
promise: Steps open as soon as their data exists, and every project reads in plain words
what: A readiness engine opens steps when inputs arrive and moves Day-N dates when inputs are late; each run shows stages, Pip's line on what is late and who owes what, and Nudge to remind them.

name: My steps
promise: All your process steps across every project, worked in one place
what: Late, today, this week and later steps from every run, what others wait on you to type in and what is coming your way, plus Copy today's update for the team.

name: Step work screens
promise: Do the work inside the step, with its checklist, guide and Pip beside you
what: Each step opens a screen for its kind of work: a versioned document, a meeting with transcript, a review or decision, a collection, with typed records (personas, facts, offers, sites) and its SOP part beside it.

name: Field forms
promise: Phone forms with geotagged photos, signatures and checklists
what: Build forms with camera-only photos stamped with time and place, signatures, locations, choices and checklists; filling one on a phone finishes the step and stores its answers on the run.

name: SOP import from Drive
promise: Turn the SOP documents you already have into steps automatically
what: Pulse finds SOP-like documents in Drive and reads them into phases, steps, owners, KPIs and approvals with a confidence and evidence for each; leadership brings each in or edits it first.

name: Scorecard and capacity
promise: Know which processes run on time and who has room for the next one
what: The scorecard shows on-time steps, first-time confirmations, revisions and verdicts per process and person; capacity adds up focused hours of open steps against each person's week.

name: Reference libraries
promise: Swipe files, reference videos and your word list, linked to the steps
what: Company libraries of swipe files, Drive reference videos, testimonials and a word list that every check reads, kept by leadership and linked from any step.

name: Industry packs
promise: Set Pulse up for your industry, words and roles in one click
what: Packs for real-estate marketing, solar, agencies, consulting, clinics and developers add starter processes, roles and record types; rename clients, projects and runs, and steps go to role holders.

name: App actions and triggers
promise: Processes start from leads, forms or schedules and act in other apps
what: Start a process by hand, from a lead, a form, a schedule or a signed web address; App action steps create quotes and invoices, calendar events, Gmail or WhatsApp drafts, X-Ray calls and webhooks.

name: Team chats and groups
promise: Direct messages, pod channels and groups with files, built into your work
what: Direct and group chats with pod and team channels, file sharing, reply quotes, edit and delete windows, presence and status, and duplicate channels quietly merged.

name: Chat side panel
promise: Open any page, Doc or link beside the conversation without leaving it
what: A tabbed side panel opens Pulse pages, Google Docs, Sheets, Slides and Drive files, or any web link next to the chat; tabs persist, and on a phone it is a bottom sheet.

name: Work from chat
promise: Give, take and track tasks right inside the conversation
what: Type '@rila draft it by Thu' to send a task card; the receiver takes, declines or asks on the card; /tasks, /projects and /steps show a group's work; files become tasks in one tap.

name: Voice messages
promise: Hold to talk, with played receipts and 2x playback
what: Record voice notes hands-free or hold-to-talk, play them with a seekable waveform at up to 2x and see when yours was heard; on-server transcription is built and switched off until enabled.

name: Voice and video calls
promise: Call a colleague or a group of up to eight without leaving Pulse
what: 1:1 and group voice or video calls from any chat or /call, ringing across browser tabs and devices, minimising to a pill while you work, with call history kept in the chat.

name: Email reader
promise: Read your Gmail inside Pulse, fast and safely
what: A Gmail-class read-only reader for each person's own mailbox, cached for instant revisits, with newsletters rendered in a sandbox and tracking links unwrapped.

name: AI employees
promise: Add AI team members who take tasks and report back in chat
what: Add an AI employee like a person (role, pod, manager) with its runtime, model, token budget, tools and memory; leaders give it tasks in chat and it posts results for approval.

name: Pip companion
promise: A friendly helper on every page for your day, alerts and quick actions
what: Pip floats on every page with one menu: check in or out, the most urgent items, notifications, Ask Pip, new task or project, do not disturb; it moves aside from buttons by itself.

name: Pip writing assistant
promise: Draft, critique and check work against your own SOPs and facts
what: Inside a step Pip outlines from the write-up, critiques against what good looks like, checks words to avoid, unconfirmed claims and stale offers, and pulls facts from transcripts; you decide.

name: WhatsApp history import
promise: Bring past WhatsApp group history into the right Pulse conversation
what: Admins preview a WhatsApp text export in the browser, map senders to colleagues and import it into a conversation readable only by its members; message text is never logged.

name: WhatsApp sender matching
promise: Decide once who each WhatsApp sender is, privately
what: A private screen where leadership and HR load names from their own exports (only names and counts leave the computer) and match each sender to a colleague before any import.

name: Team and profiles
promise: Everyone's profile, work and contact details, with AI members shown apart
what: Team lists people and AI employees with profiles holding My info, documents and history, plus their projects and deliveries found from Drive and tracker evidence for managers to confirm.

name: Org chart
promise: Who reports to whom, proposed from real work and confirmed in a click
what: An org chart with pods and departments; Pulse proposes reporting lines from rosters, roles, Workspace groups and who gives whom tasks, and HR confirms each or all above a confidence.

name: HR desk
promise: HR's whole day in five tabs: people, time, approvals, pay and policy
what: An HR desk with who is in, people, time, approvals and pay and policy; HR requests and corrections are routed to the right approver with reminders and an audit trail.

name: Automatic attendance
promise: Check-ins that happen by themselves when you reach the office
what: With consent, Pulse checks people in and out from office Wi-Fi, location and device signals and records breaks; HR sees only days it could not settle, with Confirm, Fix or Dismiss.

name: Leave, holidays and shifts
promise: Apply, approve and balance leave against your company's own rules
what: Leave types, balances, adjustments and holidays, regularisations, shift patterns with grace times, and rules HR confirms before they apply.

name: Policies and acknowledgements
promise: Publish policies and know who has read them
what: HR publishes versioned policies, including Word files read safely into text, and employees acknowledge the exact version. A browser Word editor with a fidelity check is built but off.

name: Employee onboarding
promise: New joiners set themselves up on a phone in about three minutes
what: A self-serve first run for details, emergency contact, bank details with IFSC lookup, documents (Aadhaar masked as the law requires), the app, notifications and office-presence consent.

name: Joining and leaving
promise: Checklists for every joiner and leaver, with hand-overs suggested
what: Stages from candidate to left, joining and leaving checklists Pulse proposes and HR confirms, review of people who have probably left, and hand-over of work, projects and reports.

name: Pay from offer to exit
promise: Offers, letters, salary, claims and payslips in one sealed record
what: Pay from offer to exit: offers by private link, letters, approved salary versions, one-time items and claims, with amounts sealed and reads logged; each person sees their own on My pay.

name: Payroll
promise: Run monthly payroll with payslips and a bank file in a few steps
what: Monthly payroll runs on the pay records with attendance, statutory basics (PF, ESI, professional tax, TDS), exceptions, payslips and a bank upload file; Pulse never moves money itself.

name: Skills and internal CV
promise: Verified skills and a CV people review before others read it
what: People pick skills from an approved taxonomy with levels and linked work; managers verify separately; each person reviews the internal CV others may read.

name: Internal job matching
promise: Find the right current colleague for a role, with every reason shown
what: HR describes a job's skills and Pulse explains, per requirement, how each current staff member matches, with published weights HR must accept before anyone is picked.

name: Career coach
promise: Cited next-step suggestions for growth into an internal role
what: A narrow, audited contract for a future coach that suggests next steps citing one person's job match; today only a deterministic stub exists and it is off.

name: Fair work measures
promise: Delivery measured from accepted work, never from surveillance
what: A task-derived loop measures delivery attainment from accepted work against planned commitments, with leave and training excluded; optional collectors stay off.

name: Separation of duties
promise: No one approves their own pay, leave or bank details
what: Pay set-up, bank details, leave filed for someone else and own-record changes each need a second person; written and tested on a branch, not yet live.

name: Finance overview
promise: Cash, invoices, collections and budget that explain every gap
what: Finance views for overview, reconcile, timeline, budget, cash forecast, collections, vendors and renewals, all built on reviewed sources with conserved allocations.

name: Finance entries
promise: Add expenses and payments the way you say them, with receipt photos
what: Add expenses, payments, bills, refunds and transfers with GST and receipt photos, or quick-add in plain words; payment screenshots from WhatsApp groups become entries in one tap.

name: CA desk
promise: Give your accountant read-only registers, without exposing salaries
what: A separate desk for the Accountant role with registers, monthly payroll totals by ledger and what each empty register is waiting for, behind a two-step session.

name: People cost and runway
promise: Budget against actual payroll, runway and what-if scenarios
what: This month's payroll, budget against actual by month and pod, committed pay and planned roles, cash forecast with people cost, runway and what-if scenarios that never touch records.

name: Billing and invoices
promise: Quotations, proformas, tax invoices and credit notes from draft to paid
what: Numbered GST quotations, proformas, invoices and credit notes from draft to paid with approvals, PDF and Word output, client acceptance by private link, and a full log.

name: Catalogue and inventory
promise: Services, packages and stock in one place, with price history
what: A catalogue of services, products and packages with parts, versions and price history, plus inventory of physical items with every movement kept and low-stock alerts.

name: Templates and exports
promise: Your own templates and numbering, exported to Tally or Zoho Books
what: Templates with live preview, numbering, taxes, optional fields and a billing industry pack; issued documents export as Tally XML, Zoho Books CSV or a sales register.

name: Quote follow-ups
promise: Every sent quotation gets a follow-up task until the customer answers
what: Sent quotations get their next follow-up date, a task and notice for the salesperson and a record of the customer's answer; quotes can be shared and converted safely from a phone.

name: Ad spend and growth
promise: See ad spend, client growth and project calls in one research view
what: Research views from imported datasets show ad spend, client growth and per-project calls, with aggregates for everyone and detail for the responsible team.

name: Clients
promise: Every client with their projects, deliveries, money and history
what: Client records with their projects, deliveries read from Drive, visits, money for those with access and a timeline; edits are locked against the next sync and logged.

name: Contacts
promise: Each contact's clients, projects, conversations and files on one profile
what: Contacts typed by your own categories, each with a profile of clients and projects, deliveries, team chats and your mail with them, files, notes, money and one timeline.

name: Client master and data care
promise: One clean record per client, with duplicates merged safely
what: A client master that finds duplicates by verified identifiers and merges them with reviewed decisions and undo; stewardship corrects addresses, links and map pins with history.

name: Acquisition desk
promise: Every enquiry from source to booking, with honest cost per lead
what: Lead sources, reviewed intake from forms, landing pages and CRMs via signed webhooks, distinct enquiries, contact attempts, visits and outcomes, and cost per lead only when attribution is complete.

name: Site visits
promise: Configurable site visits with photo fields and notes per customer
what: Companies define visit types and the photo fields each asks for as versioned settings; staff open and submit visits from the customer page with notes and private site photos.

name: Client portal
promise: Clients sign in to see their deliveries, approvals and billing
what: A separate client sign-in where clients see what was delivered, comment, accept or ask for changes, view linked invoices and raise support, only for projects they are granted.

name: Delivery workbench
promise: Phased delivery with internal review, client sign-off and support
what: Deliver client work in phases and parallel tracks with readiness, blockers, exact internal review, client acceptance or change requests, linked invoices and owned support.

name: Relationship graph
promise: Who works with whom across projects, developers and partners, with sources
what: Projects, developers, channel partners, clients and contacts joined by typed relationships with source, dates and status; imported links stay proposals until a named reviewer confirms.

name: Pulse Map
promise: Every development on a map, with money, markets and white space
what: Each development as a pin with how precisely its place is known, engagements, shoots, market prices, travel time and white space, and money by place for leadership with finance access.

name: Talent and models board
promise: Know which models and talent bring results, with the evidence
what: A ranked board and profile per model or talent from shoots, projects, clients and videos, with method and confidence shown; costs only for leadership with finance access.

name: Creative Strategy app
promise: Run creative sprints on a clock that moves when inputs are late
what: CS Home shows a strategist's Day-1 alerts, overdue and due work; each sprint holds the package, approver, critical inputs and dated deliverables that shift by each day an input is late.

name: Designers board
promise: See each designer's weekly deliveries by type, and why
what: A weekly board of design deliveries per designer and type, with explanations of how each was counted and designers able to claim their work.

name: Asset tracker
promise: Every deliverable with its own ID, versions and journey to live
what: Deliverables carry an Asset ID and timeline from draft to live with each date, review verdicts, counted revisions, version bumps, and script, videographer and editor notes.

name: Media review
promise: Comment on a cut at the exact moment and track every change
what: Play video versions in Pulse, comment at a timestamp and turn comments into owned changes; share drafts with clients, record each round of feedback and log the confirmation.

name: Shoot planning
promise: Plan a shoot and write the call sheet in minutes
what: Plan a shoot or visit with date, call time, place, people, shot list and equipment, then write a call sheet to copy or print, with consent and casting alongside.

name: Brand sheet
promise: Your mark, Pip and every app icon, seen as each platform shows them
what: A brand sheet with mark directions, the mark from favicon to app tile, Pip's moods and every app icon as the platforms show it; the company logo is set in Settings.

name: Sales X-Ray connection
promise: Each salesperson connects their own Sales X-Ray account securely
what: Each person connects their own Sales X-Ray account by OAuth with PKCE; tokens are sealed and bound to the person, and nothing from Sales X-Ray is copied into Pulse.

name: Calls, leads and Ask
promise: Read your analysed calls and leads, and ask about them in plain words
what: Each person reads their calls with the facts found in them and their leads, live from Sales X-Ray, and asks Pulse questions answered read-only through Sales X-Ray's MCP server.

name: Calls in processes
promise: Drop a call's summary, objections and score straight into a project step
what: A Sales X-Ray step lists your analysed calls and 'Use this call' puts its summary, asks, objections, promises and score on the step; process step names go back as lead-stage suggestions.

name: Pulse Network
promise: Companies, leaders and their AI agents posting and handing off work
what: A shared network feed, direct messages and channels with people and agents, and hand-offs from asked to done between companies; only what someone posts leaves the company. Leaders only.

name: One account, many organisations
promise: One Pulse account across every organisation you work with
what: One account linked to each organisation, a switcher (Ctrl+Shift+O) with no new sign-in, and invitations for team members, freelancers or clients by handle or private 14-day link.

name: Start your own Pulse
promise: Anyone can start their own organisation in one step
what: Name it, pick a handle and an industry pack and you own a new organisation, then switch back any time.

name: Portable profile
promise: Your profile, skills and badges travel with you between organisations
what: A profile that travels with the account: headline, skills, links, badges organisations give, highlights from finished work, and per-organisation sharing; no company records travel.

name: Licences register
promise: Every licensed Pulse install, its key and whether it is up to date
what: A central register of every organisation licensed to run Pulse, with handle, licence key and organisation ID, checking each install live for the release it runs.

name: Desktop app
promise: Check in, take breaks and see your day from the tray or menu bar
what: A Windows and Mac app with a tray or menu-bar panel (Ctrl+Alt+P) to check in, break and check out, with a live timer, next shift, requests waiting, Pip and reminders.

name: Phone app
promise: Pulse on Android with push alerts, camera and GPS site photos
what: The Pulse app for Android (and iPhone builds) wraps the web app with push notifications, verified app links, offline recovery, GPS site photos and builds per company address.

name: Chrome companion
promise: Your check-in panel one click away in the browser toolbar
what: A Chrome extension popup with check in, break, check out, timer, Pip and a status badge; optional work-site context stays opt-in.

name: Opt-in work activity
promise: Optional, privacy-first focus and idle summaries for approved work apps
what: An opt-in desktop collector records only focus and idle summaries for allow-listed work apps after a published notice; no screenshots, keystrokes or window titles are uploaded.

name: Push everywhere
promise: Alerts on phone, desktop and browser, even with Pulse closed
what: Browser web push, Android push and desktop notices, with incoming calls ringing at high priority and a single chip to turn notifications on.

name: Install, pairing and devices
promise: Install Pulse on any device and sign in with your Pulse account
what: Public install pages per platform, a pairing flow where the app shows a code you approve, and an admin view of each device's connection health plus in-app feedback with screenshots.

name: Organisation settings
promise: Name, logo, time zone, pods and teams, managed in one place
what: Admins manage the organisation's name, logo, time zone, pods, teams and the admin and HR roles; every change is written to the record history.

name: Roles and permissions
promise: Decide who can see and do what, enforced in the database
what: Roles and permissions plus a 'Who can do what' matrix for work; row-level security in the database enforces the same rules the screens show.

name: Screens and menus per role
promise: A simpler menu for each role, without changing anyone's access
what: Admins hide screens and menu entries per role and choose each role's home; hidden screens leave menus and search, while core screens always stay.

name: Module switches
promise: Turn whole modules on or off for your company
what: Companies switch off modules such as Designers, Map, Acquisition, Chats, Money or HR; an off module disappears from navigation and its API answers as if absent.

name: Sign-in and security
promise: Google, username or one-time link sign-in, with two-step for sensitive roles
what: Per-company Google sign-in, quiet sign-in, passwords, usernames and one-time links; two-step sessions for sensitive roles, new-device notices and admin-ended sessions.

name: Audit log
promise: Who did what, to which record, and when
what: An audit log filterable by actor, resource, action and date, alongside per-record change history and logged reads of sensitive data such as salaries.

name: Review data and health
promise: Clean up your data by deciding the most important suggestions first
what: Pending suggestions ranked by impact and confidence, decided group by group; Settings shows each source's freshness and Drive root health so nobody trusts stale data.

name: Sealed personal data
promise: ID documents and bank details encrypted so even the database cannot read them
what: Government ID files, bank details and pay amounts are sealed with per-file keys outside the database, with key rotation; Aadhaar and PAN are masked as Indian law requires.

name: Company setup wizard
promise: Set up a new company step by step, isolated and on its own address
what: Set up a company's details, brand, first admin, people, pods and roles, modules and industry, run an isolation check and open it for sign-in; companies start in trial until activated.

name: Data importers
promise: Bring in existing projects, tasks and finance sheets safely
what: Importers for Ops Hub projects and tasks, finance tool sheets and HR openings run as a dry run first and keep a ledger of before-values.

name: Pulse API
promise: A scoped, audited API for your apps and AI agents
what: API v1 for app keys, AI employee keys and personal tokens, with area scopes, paging, rate limits, idempotent writes and an audit receipt per call; admins issue and revoke scoped, expiring keys.

name: Developer portal
promise: API reference and a token-only try-it page for builders
what: A Developers page with quickstarts, the v1 reference and a try-it console that uses only your API key.

name: Partner agent API
promise: Let your own agents read the catalogue and leads and draft quotes
what: Service keys let a company's agents read its catalogue, clients and leads, look up by phone, create draft quotes and notify only the salesperson.

name: Signed webhooks
promise: Tell your other systems the moment something changes
what: Signed webhook posts for quotation status changes through a durable event outbox, and process webhook steps with the secret shown once.

name: Company connectors
promise: Each company connects its own sources with its own credentials
what: Admins preview, install, grant and revoke connectors for their company only, including Pulse's Drive reader or their own plugin pushing signed batches; nothing is read until enabled.

name: Google Drive sync
promise: Projects, deliveries and documents kept current from your Drive
what: An index of Drive project folders feeds projects, deliveries and SOP discovery; a direct changes feed and text capture from approved roots are built behind switches.

name: Self-hosted Pulse
promise: Run Pulse on your own server, with one-command updates and rollback
what: An install kit with backup, restore drill and an update script that migrates, health-checks and rolls back on failure; releases come from a train that runs the full test gate first.

name: Pulse CLI
promise: Script Pulse from the terminal with your API key
what: A command-line client to sign in, list operations and call any API operation with idempotency keys and paging; listed as planned on the Developers page.

name: Pulse MCP server
promise: Connect AI assistants to Pulse with only the tools your key allows
what: An MCP endpoint over Streamable HTTP at /api/v1/mcp listing only the tools a key permits; listed as planned on the Developers page.

name: WhatsApp client chat
promise: Talk to clients on WhatsApp from Pulse through your business number
what: Client conversations through a dedicated business number on WhatsApp's Cloud API with approved templates and opt-in; designed and decided, not yet built.
